title: New XL Map
changes: New XL Map has been added to the game. It has 37 hexes instead of 19, recomended for at least 4 players.

title: Initial Release
description: First production release of Klatana, a free to play and free to mantain, opensource, realtime, multiplayer turn-based strategy board game.
